module: API of the dynamic decals system (livery painting on the player vehicle) used by the editor's Dynamic Decals tool. It manages a layer stack (layerStack: decal, fill, textureFill, group, brushStroke, path, linkedSet) with undo/redo history, projects/bakes these layers into the vehicle's dynamic textures via the C++ DecalProjection binding, exposes the current projection settings (color, scale, rotation, alpha mask, mirror, SDF, path, brush) as get/set, serializes the stack to JSON and exports textures and skins (jbeam + materials) to /mods/unpacked. setup() must be called before anything else.
usage:
local dd = extensions.editor_api_dynamicDecals
dd.setup()
dd.setDecalScale(vec3(0.5, 1, 0.5))
local layer = dd.addDecal({name = "Logo"})
dd.setLayerVisibility(layer.uid, false)
dd.undo()
notes: All get/set settings functions read or write a field of the C++ decalProjection (or call its method of the same name); they crash if setup() has not been called (decalProjection = nil).
Layer additions/deletions/moves/modifications go through history:commitAction: they can be undone with undo()/redo().
setLayerVisibility modifies the layer directly (without history), unlike toggleLayerVisibility.
A layer is a table with at least uid (random hexadecimal "XXXX-XXXX" string), name, type (M.layerTypes), enabled, locked, children.

In createLayerName, the final "uid" block references a nonexistent variable `layer` (instead of layerData): it is dead because startIndex is nil at that point, so the {@uid} tag is only replaced by the final gsub on layerData.uid.
addLinkedSet_Undo/addBrushStrokeLayer_Undo remove the last layer of the root stack (#layerStack) and ignore parentUid.
The comments of M.toggleEnabled/onVehicleSwitched in the auto page come from commented-out code blocks (onEditorDeactivated, onExtensionLoaded): these hooks are not active.
The exported skin file (exportSkin) is written to /mods/unpacked/<skin>/vehicles/<vehicle>/<skin>/, then core_modmanager.checkUpdate() is called.
Layer types: decal=0, fill=1, textureFill=2, group=3, brushStroke=4, path=5, linkedSet=6.

debug.desc: Enables detailed logs (print) in most functions. false by default.

blendModes.desc: Blend modes {name, value}: Clear 0, Normal 1, Screen / Add 2, Subtract 3, Multiply 4, Eraser 5.

settingsFlags.desc: Projector setting flags ({name, value[, description]}): None, UseMousePos (bit 2), UseGradientColor (3), AlphaMaskInvert (4), WrapAlphaMaskX (5), WrapAlphaMaskY (6), WrapColorTextureX (7), WrapColorTextureY (8).

loadingModes.desc: Stack loading modes {key, value}: Overwrite 0, Append 1 (for loadLayerStackFromFile).

layerTypes.desc: decal 0, fill 1, textureFill 2, group 3, brushStroke 4, path 5, linkedSet 6.

layerBakingStatusCode.desc: Baking result flags (res.status): Ok 0, Warning 1, Error 2, LayerStackDataTypeIncorrect 4, LayerDataTypeIncorrect 8, TextureFileMissing 16, FontFileMissing 32.

projectDynamicDecals.desc: If true (default), onUpdate_ projects the preview decal under the camera every frame.

types.desc: Property types for M.properties: bool 0, int 1, float 2, Point2F 3, Point3F 4, Point4F 5, string 6, Texture 7, File 8, ColorI 9, MultiColor 10.

widgetTypes.desc: For each property type, table of possible widgets (Default, Input, Slider, Drag, Combo, Checkbox, Color, File, ImageButton, ColorGradient, InputMultiline depending on the type).

properties.desc: Description of the editable properties per layer type (Decal, etc.): id, name, description, type, default, min/max for the widget, format, getMod/setMod, widgetType.

setup.desc: Initializes the projector: uses the active DecalShapeRenderApp app if it exists, otherwise creates a DecalProjection (4096x2048) bound to the player vehicle; fetches the textureSet, updates the vehicle materials and adds a base fill layer if the stack is empty. No effect if already done.

updateVehicleMaterials.desc: Starts a job that chooses the default decal material(s) based on the player vehicle (materials of its parts, otherwise the material named after the jbeam, otherwise ending with main then body).

setLayerNameBuildString.desc: Sets the name template for new layers (default "$type Layer"). Tags: @type, @colormap, @normalmap, @metallicmap, @roughnessmap, @alphamap, @uid; a {text@tag text} block only appears if the tag is not empty.

addDecal.desc: Creates a decal layer from the current projection (camera + settings), bakes it and adds it to the stack (undoable). If not all meshes are enabled, limits the decal to the vehicle's enabled meshes.

addMaskDecal.desc: Adds a decal to the mask (layer.mask.layers) of the given layer, from the current projection (undoable).

layerUid_string.desc: uid of the layer to mask

addFillLayer.desc: Adds a color fill layer (current fillLayer color and palette), undoable.

addTextureFillLayer.desc: Adds a texture fill layer (current fillTexturePath, scale, offset), undoable.

addGroup.desc: Adds a group layer (can contain children), undoable.

addLinkedSet.desc: Adds a "linked set" layer (type 6, with a properties table), undoable. Undo removes the last root layer.

addBrushStrokeLayer.desc: Adds a brush stroke layer from getBrushStrokeLayerData(), undoable.

addPathDataPoint.desc: Adds a point to the current path layer (creates it on the first call with the current path settings: orientDecals, pathType, interpolationSteps, text, fontPath), then reprojects.

setEnablePathLayer.desc: Enables/disables path mode; when set to false, finishes the current path.

getEnablePathLayer.desc: Returns whether path mode is active.

hasActivePathLayer.desc: true if a path layer is currently being edited.

finishPathLayer.desc: Finishes the current path (the next points will create a new path).

removeLastPathLayerPoint.desc: Removes the last point of the current path; if only one remains, deletes the layer.

setEnableBrushStroke.desc: Enables/disables the projector's brush mode (with a new random uid).

getBrushStrokeLayerData.desc: Data of the current brush layer (C++ side).

getOrientPathDecals.desc: Whether decals follow the path direction.

setOrientPathDecals.desc: Sets whether the path's decals are oriented along the path.

setPathLayerText.desc: Sets the text placed along the path.

getDecalLayerFontCharacter.desc: Font character used by the decal.

getFontTextureAtlasPath.desc: Path of the font texture atlas.

changeDecalSize.desc: Enlarges/shrinks the current decal (x and z of decalScale) by one step (0.025 by default).

changeDecalRotation.desc: Rotates the current decal by one step (15 degrees by default, in radians).

bakeLayers.desc: Bakes a list of layers into the player vehicle's textures (decalProjection:bakeLayers). Returns nil with a message if there is no vehicle.

reprojectLayers.desc: Clears the baked textures and rebakes the whole stack; shows a failure if baking returns nil.

clearLayerStack.desc: Clears the layer stack and the baked textures (undoable).

getLayerStack.desc: Returns the root layer stack (shared table, not a copy).

getLayerByUid.desc: Looks up a layer (recursively) by uid; logs a message and returns nil if not found.

getLayerById.desc: Returns the layer at the given index (1-based) in the root stack or in the parent's children.

setLayer.desc: Replaces a layer (by uid) with the given data, undoable, and emits dynamicDecals_setLayer(uid); dynamicDecals_onLayerUpdated(uid) is emitted on apply.

replaceDecalTransformFromCurrentProjecti.desc: Repositions an already placed decal according to the current camera/projection, changing only its transform fields (camPosition, decalPos, decalScale, decalRotation, mirror...). Refuses if the captured cursor is not centered (0.5 ± 0.01) or if the layer is not a decal. Commits a "Transform Decal" action.

originalLayer.desc: Snapshot of the layer before the edit

moveLayer.desc: Moves a layer to another position/parent (undoable). Refuses to make a layer its own child. Emits dynamicDecals_moveLayer.

removeLayer.desc: Deletes a layer (undoable) and turns off highlighting if it was highlighted.

duplicateLayer.desc: Duplicates a layer (new uids, name + " Copy") right after the original (undoable).

duplicateAndMirrorLayer.desc: Duplicates a layer by mirroring it (name + " Mirrored Copy") right after the original (undoable).

setLayerVisibility.desc: Shows/hides a layer directly (without history) and reprojects.

toggleLayerVisibility.desc: Toggles a layer's visibility (undoable) and reprojects.

moveLayerLocalPos.desc: Moves a layer (decal, brushStroke, path or group) to a new vehicle-local position. For a group, referenceLayerUid is required.

rotateLayer.desc: Applies a delta rotation to a layer and its children.

scaleLayer.desc: Scales a layer and its children by (1,1,1) + delta.

serializeLayer.desc: Converts a layer to a JSON-serializable table (engine types converted).

deserializeLayer.desc: Rebuilds a layer from serialized data.

saveLayerStackToFile.desc: Writes the layer stack to a JSON file (without materialIdx).

loadLayerStackFromFile.desc: Loads a stack from a JSON, overwriting (Overwrite, default) or appending (Append), then reprojects.

returns.desc: Result of reprojectLayers (nil in the current code, the function returns nothing)

exportTextures.desc: Exports the baked textures to a folder.

exportLayerMask.desc: Exports a layer's mask to a file.

exportSkin.desc: Exports a skin usable as a mod: png textures (_d, _m, _r, _cp), <mat>.skin.<skinName> materials copied from the <mat>.skin.dynamicTextures presets and the skin's jbeam file (slotType paint_design) to /mods/unpacked/<skinName>/..., then refreshes the mod manager.

getSettings.desc: Bit mask of the projector settings (M.settingsFlags).

isUseMousePos.desc: Is the UseMousePos flag active (projection at the mouse cursor rather than the center)?

getDecalTexturePath.desc: Path of the current texture of a decal type.

type_string.desc: Texture type (color, normal, metallic, roughness, alpha, inferred from the decal*TexturePath fields)

setDecalTexturePath.desc: Sets the current texture of a decal type.

getAlphaMaskChannel.desc: Alpha mask channel (0 to 3 according to the property bounds).

getAlphaMaskBlendMode.desc: Alpha mask blend mode (0 or 1 according to the property bounds).

setAlphaMaskBlendMode.desc: Sets the alpha mask blend mode.

setGradientColorTopLeft.desc: Sets the gradient color, top-left corner.

setGradientColorTopRight.desc: Sets the gradient color, top-right corner.

setGradientColorBottomLeft.desc: Sets the gradient color, bottom-left corner.

setGradientColorBottomRight.desc: Sets the gradient color, bottom-right corner.

getColorPaletteMapId.desc: Index of the vehicle color palette used by the decal.

setFillLayerColor.desc: Sets the color of the fill layers.

setFillLayerColorPaletteMapId.desc: Sets the palette index for the fill.

getTextureFillLayerScale.desc: Scale of the texture fill layers.

getFlipMirroredDecal.desc: Flip the decal on the mirror side?

setFlipMirroredDecal.desc: Enables flipping of the decal on the mirror side.

getUseSurfaceNormal.desc: Orient the decal along the surface normal?

setUseSurfaceNormal.desc: Enables orientation along the surface normal.

renderSdfTextureImgui.desc: Displays the SDF texture in ImGui.

getShapePath.desc: Path of the 3D model (shape) projected onto.

setShapePath.desc: Changes the projection model then reprojects.

getShapeMeshes.desc: Shape meshes and their activation state.

getMeshObjectCount.desc: Number of meshes in the shape.

areAllMeshesEnabled.desc: true if all meshes are enabled.

setTextureResolution.desc: Changes the resolution; if the engine accepts it, reprojects and reassigns the @DynamicTexture textureSet.

setUvLayer.desc: Changes the UV channel then reprojects.

setMaterialIdx.desc: Sets the single material targeted by the projection.

addMaterialIdx.desc: Adds a material to the targets.

removeMaterialIdx.desc: Removes a material from the targets.

clearMaterialIdx.desc: Clears the list of targeted materials.

getDecalWorldPos.desc: World position of a decal layer.

getDecalLocalPos.desc: Local (vehicle) position of a decal layer.

setDecalLocalPos.desc: Sets a decal's position (parameter name is worldPos in the code).

getDecalWorldTransform.desc: World transform matrix of a layer.

getCursorPosition.desc: Position of the projection cursor (screen, UV).

setCursorPosition.desc: Sets the position of the projection cursor.

setEnabled.desc: Enables/disables the projector; when set to false, clears the dynamic textures and recombines the textureSet.

toggleEnabled.desc: Toggles the projector state (same effects as setEnabled).

getTextureSet.desc: TextureSet of the dynamic textures (nil before setup).

drawDynamicTextures.desc: Displays the dynamic textures in ImGui.

drawBakedTextures.desc: Displays the baked textures in ImGui.

drawHighlightTextures.desc: Displays the highlight textures in ImGui.

drawBrushInputTextures.desc: Displays the brush input textures in ImGui.

drawMaskTextures.desc: Displays the mask textures in ImGui.

drawTextureSet.desc: Displays a given textureSet in ImGui.

getHistory.desc: Undo/redo history specific to this module.

undo.desc: Undoes the last action of the decals history.

onSerialize.desc: Extension serialization hook: returns {layerStackData, materialIdx} (nil without a projector).

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called with the saved data: recreates the layer stack and remembers materialIdx for setup().

onUpdate_.desc: Called every frame by the tool: updates the app, projects the preview decal if projectDynamicDecals is set, then combines the textures into the textureSet.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called on vehicle switch: refreshes the shape and the materials.
